name: E2E Teamwork - task updates
description: Fresh project/tasklist/task, then ChangeTaskAssignees (the connected user), ChangeTaskDueDate (+7 days), tag via MakeApiCall → ChangeTaskTags → ListTags; deletes project and tag.

6f46dd50-aee8-4c3f-9fb3-af81040e18ae.content:
## ⚠️ Test data assumption

ChangeTaskAssignees needs a user who is a member of the fresh project — only the project creator is. ListPeople therefore searches for the connected account `auth@appmixer.ai`; on another site change the searchTerm to that account's e-mail (sample users are not project members and Teamwork answers "users do not have access to the task").
